name: De nui nhung me
summary: Mountain goat dipped in mẻ, fermented rice, at the goat tables on the roads to the sights. The meat is firm, because the goats climb the limestone.
origin: Ninh Bình, on the roads toward the sights.
where: The roads and lanes toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính, where the dê núi shops are.
seoTitle: De nui nhung me — goat in fermented rice
seoDescription: Ninh Bình mountain goat dipped in mẻ, fermented rice, on the goat roads toward the karst sights.
